extracted.name: Chocolate Milkshake
extracted.description: This easy Chocolate Milkshake recipe is thick and creamy, made in just a few minutes, with only three simple ingredients.
ingredient_lines: 6 cups vanilla ice cream or chocolate ice cream
1/3 cup milk (, or more as needed, or use chocolate milk)
instruction_lines: Combine ice cream, milk and chocolate sauce in a blender and blend until combined. I like my shakes really thick, but if you need to thin it, add a little more milk.
